text:
laura - Partnerships: Quick heads-up — we need to finalize the marketplace pricing + metering plan for AWS/GCP/Azure listings. Main goals: SKU mapping, metering event contract, free-trial bundle behavior, and support tier labels. Who can help triage this today?

sam - Product: I can run point. I want a short doc that maps our SKU/plan names -> marketplace SKUs + which usage dimensions we’ll meter (token, request, seat?).

raj - Eng: FYI metering events for AWS/Azure are generally event-based (put-metering-record). GCP has usage-export patterns. We should pick a canonical event payload. Example we use internally: 
```json
{
  "customer_id": "acct_123",
  "sku": "redwood-gen-standard-v1",
  "usage": {"tokens": 12345, "requests": 12},
  "timestamp": 1680000000
}
```
This aligns with our billing pipeline.

katie - Legal: Two legal points — marketplaces require a publisher agreement + terms for trials. For Azure private offers we need a separate addendum. Also we must verify Redwood's privacy snippets for the listings (data residency + processor/subprocessor callouts). I'll draft a checklist.

miguel - Solutions: From the field, customers expect "trial auto-convert" vs "trial paywall" options. We should let product pick one per SKU. Also recommend a "support level" tag (standard/premium) exposed in listing.

laura - Partnerships: Good. Can we list concrete action items? I propose: 1) Product to produce SKU mapping CSV, 2) Eng to standardize metering payload + example, 3) Legal to list required agreements per cloud, 4) Solutions to propose trial UX text + support labels, 5) Partnerships to collect assets (icons, marketing blurb, localized short description). Deadline EOD Thu?

sam - Product: Ack. I'll start the CSV. Quick question: do we want single SKU per region or region-agnostic SKU with region mapping later? My leaning: one SKU per cloud, region mapping handled in marketplace metadata.

raj - Eng: Region-agnostic SKU is simpler on our side. We'll include a "region" optional field in the metering event if needed. Also note: AWS meterable dimensions are flat; multi-dim billing requires separate dimension registration. We should limit to 2 dims (tokens, requests) to start.

katie - Legal: For EULA/trial terms we need a short statement for marketplace listing (<=200 chars) and a link to the full terms. Partnerships, can you confirm where to host the terms doc? Prefer Redwood public legal pages but private offers sometimes require explicit URL for the publisher.

laura - Partnerships: We'll host on a gated S3 URL for private offers, and a public page for marketplace listing. I'll post links when ready.

miguel - Solutions: For trial copy, propose: "14-day free trial with up to 100k tokens per month. After trial, usage billed per token." Also add note: "Enterprise support available" as a banner. I'll put options into a quick doc.

ops-bot: Reminder: marketplace-onboard checklist created: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/onboard/2147777000 - please attach SKU CSV there.

sam - Product: Uploaded initial SKU CSV to the checklist (link). Pinged eng for metering schema review.

raj - Eng: Reviewed CSV. One technical callout: our internal model variants map (gen-standard/gen-pro) -> marketplace SKUs needs to include quantization/size metadata so Dedicated customers pick compatible variants. I'll add a column.

katie - Legal: Added required agreement templates to the checklist. Also flagged Azure private-offer addendum as blocking for Azure listing if customer uses private offers.

laura - Partnerships: Thanks all. Plan: sync 30m tomorrow 9am PT to finalize CSV + trial copy. Action owners: sam (SKU CSV), raj (metering schema + dimension registration steps), katie (agreements + short-term hosting URL), miguel (trial copy + support tags), laura (assets + marketplace submission).

sam - Product: 9am PT works. I'll send calendar invite.

raj - Eng: 👍 I'll prepare a sample publish request and test script for AWS put-metering-record.

miguel - Solutions: I'll prepare two variations of trial UX (auto-convert vs explicit opt-in) and notes on how to surface support tiers.

laura - Partnerships: Great. If anyone runs into blockers earlier, DM me. I'll track progress in the checklist. :thumbsup:
